page.layout: One block: title page, all lines centred in one column; a woodcut ornament below the author line; the imprint below the ornament. No margins with text.
page.notes: Woodcut ornament (cherub with foliage and drapery) between the author line and the imprint; not transcribed. Small pen marks and show-through at the top and right edge are not printed text. The imprint rule under "le Preux." is a printed line, not text.
